name: inetsim
summary: A software suite for simulating common internet services in a lab environment, e.g. for analyzing the network behaviour of unknown malware samples.
highlights: --bind-address — Default IP address to bind services to. Overrides configuration option 'default_bind_addre
--max-childs — Default maximum number of child processes per service. Overrides configuration option 'def
--user — Default user to run services. Overrides configuration option 'default_run_as_user'.
--faketime-init-delta — Initial faketime delta (seconds). Overrides configuration option 'faketime_init_delta'.

flags.name: --bind-address
flags.description: Default IP address to bind services to. Overrides configuration option 'default_bind_address'.

flags.name: --max-childs
flags.description: Default maximum number of child processes per service. Overrides configuration option 'default_max_childs'.

flags.name: --user
flags.description: Default user to run services. Overrides configuration option 'default_run_as_user'.

flags.name: --faketime-init-delta
flags.description: Initial faketime delta (seconds). Overrides configuration option 'faketime_init_delta'.

flags.name: --faketime-auto-delay
flags.description: Delay for auto incrementing faketime (seconds). Overrides configuration option 'faketime_auto_delay'.

flags.name: --faketime-auto-incr
flags.description: Delta for auto incrementing faketime (seconds). Overrides configuration option 'faketime_auto_increment'.

flags.name: --session
flags.description: Session id to use. Defaults to main process id.

flags.name: --pidfile
flags.description: Pid file to use. Defaults to '/run/inetsim.pid'.
